title: Adults dream during REM (rapid eye movement) sleep and infan…

sents.en: Adults dream during REM (rapid eye movement) sleep and infants have loads of REM.
sents.cn: 成年人在REM（快速眼动）睡眠期间会做梦，婴儿则有大量快速眼动睡眠。

sents.en: So, it might be fair to assume that babies have tons of dreams.
sents.cn: 因此，认为婴儿会做很多梦，这一假设或许不无道理。

sents.en: But scientists believe REM serves a completely different purpose for newborns and infants than dreaming.
sents.cn: 但科学家认为，REM对新生儿和婴儿的作用与做梦完全不同。

sents.en: When babies are in REM, it allows their brain to develop pathways, connections, and eventually, learn languages.
sents.cn: 当婴儿处于快速眼动睡眠时，它让大脑得以发育出神经通路和连接，并最终学会语言。

sents.en: Since your baby doesn't dream at this stage of brain development, it's safe to assume babies do not have nightmares, either.
sents.cn: 既然你的宝宝在大脑发育的这一阶段不做梦，那么可以放心地认为婴儿也不会做噩梦。

sents.en: Nightmares stem from exposure to trauma (创伤)，an overactive imagination, and the normal stresses of everyday life.
sents.cn: 噩梦源于遭受创伤、过于活跃的想象力，以及日常生活带来的正常压力。

sents.en: Are you wondering, what do babies dream about?
sents.cn: 你是否在想，婴儿会梦到什么？

sents.en: Good question, but the answer is nothing!
sents.cn: 问得好，但答案是：什么也不梦！

sents.en: So, when do babies start dreaming?
sents.cn: 那么，婴儿从什么时候开始做梦呢？

sents.en: The general consensus is that they start dreaming around the age of two.
sents.cn: 普遍共识是，他们大约在两岁开始做梦。

sents.en: Psychologist David Foulkes studies children (from very small kids to teens) to bring the secrets of their dreams to the light of day.
sents.cn: 心理学家大卫∙福尔克斯（DavidFoulkes）研究儿童（从很小的孩子到青少年），以揭开他们梦境的秘密。

sents.en: In his lab, he lets kids fall asleep and then wakes them 3 times a night and asks them to describe what they recall.
sents.cn: 在他的实验室里，他让孩子们入睡，然后每晚把他们唤醒3次，请他们描述自己记得的内容。

sents.en: Foulkes' findings are unsurprising.
sents.cn: 福尔克斯的发现并不出人意料。

sents.en: Basically, little kids have little dreams.
sents.cn: 基本上，小孩子做的只是小梦。

sents.en: But exactly what kids see while dreaming depends on their age.
sents.cn: 但孩子做梦时究竟看到什么，取决于他们的年龄。

sents.en: As children develop and grow, their dreams do too.
sents.cn: 随着儿童发育成长，他们的梦也会随之变化。

sents.en: Dreams of very small kids are usually just snapshots (快照), looking much more like a slideshow than a movie, when compared to the dreams of adults.
sents.cn: 相比之下，非常小孩子的梦通常只是一些快照，与成人的梦相比，更像幻灯片而非电影。

sents.en: They heavily feature animals and other familiar sights, like images of people eating.
sents.cn: 它们大量出现动物和其他熟悉的景象，比如人们吃东西的画面。

sents.en: According to Foulkes, · Children's dream life...seems to be similar to their waking imagination and narration.· Kids ages 5 · 9 begin seeing moving images and characters in action.
sents.cn: 据福尔克斯说："儿童的梦境……似乎与他们清醒时的想象和叙述相似。"5到9岁的孩子开始看到动态影像和正在行动的角色。

sents.en: Dreams now include multiple events strung together, one after the other.
sents.cn: 梦境现在包含串联在一起、一个接一个的多个事件。

sents.en: They also start developing greater ability to remember dreams.
sents.cn: 他们也开始具备更强的记梦能力。

sents.en: Still, that's not always the case: When roused during REM sleep, 25% of the kids in Foulkes' studies had no recollection of dreaming, a trend that continues through age 9.
sents.cn: 不过，情况也并非总是如此：在快速眼动睡眠中被唤醒时，福尔克斯研究中25%的孩子对做梦毫无印象，这一趋势一直持续到9岁。

sents.en: So, if your baby seems to be in a stressful state while sleeping or is upset upon waking, there may be other factors at play.
sents.cn: 所以，如果你的宝宝在睡眠中似乎处于紧张状态，或醒来时不快，可能有其他的因素在起作用。
